name: STAINLESS STEEL GLOVE BOX
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Stainless Steel Glove Box is a heavy-duty isolation chamber designed for rigorous physics, chemistry, nuclear, and battery research (Lithium-ion). Constructed from 3mm thick Stainless Steel 304 (optional SS316), it features a wide-angle 10mm tempered glass viewing window without dead spaces. Equipped with an antechamber and silicone-sealed side doors, this unit ensures absolute atmospheric isolation, making it perfect for stringent test requirements handling highly reactive compounds.
features: Heavy-duty construction using 3mm thick Stainless Steel 304 (SS 316 optional)
Wide-angle 10mm tempered glass front panel for dead-space-free viewing
Includes a vacuum-capable antechamber (-0.1MPa) for safe material transfer
High-durability latex or butyl gloves with airtight silicone rubber sealing rings
KF flanges provided as standard for easy future upgrades and attachments
Optional oil-filled vacuum pump, movable stand, and automated controllers

specifications.Side Door Size (L*W): 350 * 300 mm with silicone seal and pull action clamp
specifications.Internal Fittings: Main chamber gas purge valve, internal electric socket, White LED light
specifications.Pressure Monitoring: Dial type pressure gauge installed for the antechamber
specifications.Exterior Finish: Spray white paint or buffed stainless steel
specifications.Optional Integrations: Main chamber vacuum, Dew point analyzer, Humidity controller
